verdict.rationale: Vue.js is a client-side UI framework for building web interfaces. Setting up autonomous background automations, such as scheduled or agentic jobs, belongs to a hosted platform or agent product, not a rendering framework. Nothing in the evidence shows Vue shipping such a capability; the testing guide's mention of E2E runs in CI/CD pipelines describes user-side tooling, not a Vue automation feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
